easy.example: I understand the rules of the game.

more.def: To know the meaning of something or how it works.
more.example: After the teacher drew a picture, I understood the math problem.

easy.def: Everything there is: the Earth, the sun, the stars, and all of space.
easy.example: There are many stars in the universe.

more.def: Everything that exists, including all the stars, planets, and space.
more.example: Scientists use telescopes to study faraway parts of the universe.

easy.def: Not what you see every day.
easy.example: A blue apple would be unusual.

more.def: Not common or ordinary; different from what you expect.
more.example: It is unusual to see snow here in April.

easy.def: Able to help you do something.
easy.example: A map is useful on a trip.

more.def: Helpful; able to be used for a purpose.
more.example: A flashlight is a useful thing to bring on a camping trip.
